name: bastra-recall
description: Persistent local memory for Claude — recalls before acting, saves what matters.
long_description: Bastra Recall gives Claude a durable, local-first memory: a folder of plain Markdown files (Obsidian-compatible) served by one local daemon that every AI tool on your machine shares. Claude recalls your preferences, lessons and project facts before acting, and saves durable rules, decisions and facts as they come up — storage and keyword search are local, while retrieved memories are passed to Claude as context. Optional remote embeddings send queries and indexed memory text to the selected provider. This extension bundles the MCP forwarder; the shared daemon is started automatically on first use. Fresh vault? The vault map and `bastra onboard` run a 5-minute onboarding interview, Claude joins in on its first bastra call, and `bastra import` brings memories over from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini exports.
